name: Everdisplay Optronics (Shanghai) Co., Ltd.
summary: Everdisplay Optronics (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. researches, develops, produces, and sells high-resolution small and medium-sized active-matrix organic light-emitting diode (AMOLED) semiconductor display panels in China and internationally. It offers AMOLED semiconductor display panel products for automotive, aviation, desktop, smart home, industrial control, and medical displays. The company's products are used in consumer electronic products, including smartphones, smart wearables, tablets/notebooks, and laptops. Everdisplay Optronics (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2012 and is based in Shanghai, China.
